description: This Java source file defines an abstract class CheckPermissionsVisitor that implements permission checking logic for ResourceNode objects within a permission enforcement framework. It includes methods for visiting tree nodes, aggregating permissions, and determining permission grants based on weighted permissions.

classes.name: CheckPermissionsVisitor
classes.description: An abstract class for visitors that check permissions on ResourceNode objects, evaluating whether specified subjects have the expected permissions based on weighted permission data.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a tree node, delegating to subject or resource node handlers based on node type.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles visiting a subject node, setting permission collection flag if the subject is relevant.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles visiting a resource node, aggregating permissions if applicable.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for aggregating permissions from a resource node.

methods.name: getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Returns the relative location of a resource node in relation to the target resource pointer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the boolean result of the permission check.
